title: Weekly tip
body: A welcome bonus is only good if you can meet the requirement without overspending. Never spend extra just to chase a bonus.
scorePrompt: Help me understand if a credit card welcome bonus is worth it.

title: Weekly tip
body: If you are optimizing credit, the balance that reports on statement day matters. Let a small amount report, then pay it down before the due date.
scorePrompt: Explain credit utilization before the statement date in simple terms.

title: Weekly tip
body: Do not file too early if you are still waiting on 1099s. HYSA interest, dividends, and sold investments can all create forms.
ctaText: Ask Score for a tax form checklist
scorePrompt: Build my tax form checklist before I file.

title: Weekly tip
body: A Roth IRA is built for retirement tax advantages. A brokerage account is more flexible, but it does not have the same retirement tax shelter.
scorePrompt: Help me understand Roth IRA versus brokerage account basics.

title: Weekly tip
body: HYSA interest can be taxable. The account is still useful, but keep the 1099-INT in mind when tax season comes around.
scorePrompt: Explain HYSA interest taxes and 1099-INT basics.

title: Weekly tip
body: Keep daily cash separate from savings. Checking is for bills and access; savings is for money you are trying not to touch.
scorePrompt: Help me set up checking and savings without mixing daily cash with emergency savings.

title: Weekly tip
body: A travel card annual fee needs a job. If the credits, transfer partners, or trip benefits are not real for your life, the fee is just noise.
scorePrompt: Help me decide if a travel card annual fee has a real job in my setup.

title: Weekly tip
body: Your first card is for history, not flexing. One simple card, small purchases, autopay on, and paid in full beats a messy stack.
scorePrompt: Help me choose a simple first credit card setup as a student.

title: Weekly tip
body: Automate bills before investing. A clean system starts with no missed due dates, then savings, then long-term investing.
ctaText: Ask Score for a money plan
scorePrompt: Build me a simple money plan: bills, savings, and investing order.

title: Weekly tip
body: Student tax credits may apply if you paid eligible education costs. A 1098-T starts the question, but eligibility still matters.
scorePrompt: Explain AOTC and Lifetime Learning Credit basics for students.

title: Weekly tip
body: Do not confuse the account with the investment. A Roth IRA is the container; ETFs, funds, stocks, and bonds are what go inside.
ctaText: Ask Score about Roth IRA basics
scorePrompt: Explain the difference between an account and an investment inside a Roth IRA.

title: Weekly tip
body: Never carry debt for rewards. Interest can erase cash back, points, and bonuses fast. Pay in full first; optimize second.
scorePrompt: Explain why carrying credit card debt for rewards is a bad idea.
